notes: TEMPLATE (neutral). ${hpo.candidates} is the whole candidate object (9 generated grid candidates); feature_indices are computed from ${features} names, the fixture holds the literals.  STEP 6 HPO: grid over hidden layers and learning rate for the step-5 winner on the warm-up folds (shown for an MLP winner; if step 5 picks GRU, swap the encoder). The selected candidate is frozen. STEP 7 (signal validation) is this same document's remaining stages, run after search: --stage select, --stage evaluate --partition development (warm-up), --stage evaluate --partition later (SCORED folds only: retrain per fold, frozen choices, holdout refused), --stage report. The report compares the winner with both baselines using the study's paired block bootstrap.

data.notes: exact_dte = step 1's selected exact expiry for this ticker (QQQ: 7); data.root is the onboarding store; surface, lifecycle, chain_features, archive_root and decision_regions.archive_root are store references (source, stream and, for a file, relpath, resolved against data.root; add manifest_sha256 to pin a snapshot). Change symbols/exact_dte per ticker, or the references to read another onboarded source. decision_regions (the block refuses its own notes key): Wing region = for each side, the span from the lowest to the highest quotable strike within |log K/S| <= 0.1 (puts: lowest valid ask to highest valid bid; calls: lowest valid bid to highest valid ask), every strike in between included, no wing-width limit (owner ruling 2026-10-02: the whole region matters and a width cap only created holes and an enumeration blow-up); the loss weights each side's span. panel_years spans the whole archive (2011-2025) so every warm-up and scored fold has strike regions; the holdout is dropped before contexts are built.

study.notes: Folds come from step 3's fold table (ADR-0222/0223), which carries date boundaries and complete-case counts only: the study slices every panel row inside a fold's boundaries and median-imputes the dates missing an admitted family (about 8% of QQQ dev dates), so training is NOT complete-case. Owner decision 2026-10-02 (option A): median imputation is ACCEPTED and no complete-case filter will be built. Warm-up folds for search, selection and the development evaluation; scored folds only for the frozen 'later' evaluation; the holdout is refused by the study. cal_n = 40 dates (one validation window) is the inner slice of each training window used ONLY for patience early stopping (never the scored window). Replace path/sha256/holdout_start with the values printed by the step-3 run for this ticker/source/expiry. Baselines: horizon_empirical = the historical (empirical) return CDF fitted on each fold's training rows (signal = beat it); option_proxy_transport = the option-implied CDF from the entry chain's rn_q quantiles (market edge = beat it).

experiment.notes: Selection on warm-up folds by wing-weighted twCRPS (ADR-0218). Training: 0.1*NLL + 1.0*wing twCRPS, patience 6 on the inner cal slice is the only exit; epochs 2000 is a guard that raises if reached while still improving (ADR-0223). feature_indices = the step-4 winner's column positions in study.features (empty is refused, so an unfilled run cannot start). GRU sequence/context indices are positions WITHIN that subset: sequence_indices is a list of ROWS, one row per step oldest first, each row the subset position(s) of that step's channel, here [[ret_lag_21], ..., [ret_lag_0]] (one return per step); context_indices is a flat list of all other subset positions.
